fruits.name: Rocket
fruits.description: An entry-level Natural fruit with rocket and explosion-based attacks. Affordable starting option for new players.

abilities.name: Missile Fist
abilities.description: A rocket-propelled punch that launches the user forward

abilities.name: Air Strike
abilities.description: Fires an aerial explosive projectile

abilities.description: A high-speed diving attack using rocket propulsion

strengths: Very affordable; accessible starting option
Basic mobility and range for early game
weaknesses: Low damage output in mid- and late-game content
No passive defensive ability

abilities.name: Afterimage Assault
abilities.description: Moves at high speed while attacking, creating afterimages

abilities.name: Transformation
abilities.description: Transforms into the tiger form with enhanced speed and power

abilities.name: Body Flicker
abilities.description: Teleports instantly to enemy locations at blinding speed

strengths: Body Flicker provides exceptional gap-closing capability
Afterimage Assault is difficult to evade
Top-ranked Beast fruit in community tier lists
weaknesses: High Beli cost limits early-game access
Requires good timing to maximize Body Flicker

fruits.name: Yeti
fruits.description: A Mythical Beast fruit granting a powerful yeti transformation with ice and frost abilities.

abilities.name: Arctic Clap
abilities.description: Claps with ice-cold yeti force, generating a frost shockwave

abilities.name: Frostbite Boulder
abilities.description: Throws a massive frozen boulder at enemies

abilities.name: Glacial Execution
abilities.description: Delivers a devastating ice-powered execution strike

abilities.name: Transformation
abilities.description: Transforms into the massive yeti form

abilities.name: Tundra Rush
abilities.description: Charges through enemies in a powerful frozen rush

strengths: High physical damage in yeti transformation
Frostbite Boulder is a strong ranged option for a Beast fruit
A-tier in community rankings
weaknesses: Large yeti hitbox in transformation
Somewhat slower than Tiger at the same tier

fruits.name: Kitsune
fruits.description: A Mythical Beast fruit granting a fox spirit (kitsune) transformation with cursed fire abilities. S-tier and one of the highest-priced Beast fruits.

abilities.name: Accursed Enchantment
abilities.description: Casts a cursed enchantment that debilitates the target

abilities.name: Tails of Burning Agony
abilities.description: Strikes with multiple burning fox tails simultaneously

abilities.name: Fox Fire Disruption
abilities.description: Creates fox fire that disrupts and disorients enemies

abilities.name: Transformation
abilities.description: Transforms into the multi-tailed kitsune spirit form

abilities.name: Wild Assault
abilities.description: A rapid and relentless multi-hit assault

strengths: Fox Fire Disruption creates strong offensive pressure
Wild Assault deals rapid successive hits
S-tier in community tier lists
weaknesses: Very high acquisition cost
Requires good mastery of the transformation to play effectively

fruits.name: Dragon
fruits.description: A Mythical Beast fruit granting a powerful dragon transformation with fire-based attacks. The most expensive fruit available from the Blox Fruit Dealer.

abilities.name: Heatwave Cannon
abilities.description: Fires a devastating heatwave cannon blast at long range

abilities.name: Infernal Pincer
abilities.description: Grabs and crushes enemies with fiery dragon claws

abilities.name: Scorching Downfall
abilities.description: Drops concentrated fire from above onto enemies

abilities.name: Imperial Evolution
abilities.description: Achieves an evolved dragon form with significantly enhanced power

abilities.name: Draconic Soar
abilities.description: Soars through the air at high speed in dragon form

strengths: Extremely high damage across all abilities
Imperial Evolution dramatically increases combat power
Draconic Soar provides fast flight mobility
S-tier in community tier lists
weaknesses: The most expensive fruit in the game
Large dragon hitbox in transformation mode

fruits.name: Empyrean
fruits.description: A Mythical Beast mutation variant of Kitsune with a distinct visual appearance. Community tier rankings place it at S-tier alongside its base form.
strengths: Mutation variant of S-tier Kitsune with distinct visual appearance
weaknesses: Specific ability differences from base Kitsune not verified from current sources

fruits.name: Fiend
fruits.description: A Mythical Beast mutation variant of Yeti with a distinct visual appearance. Community tier rankings place it at S-tier, above the base Yeti form.
strengths: Mutation variant of Yeti with distinct visual appearance
S-tier in community tier lists
weaknesses: Specific ability differences from base Yeti not verified from current sources

fruits.name: Werewolf
fruits.description: A Mythical Beast mutation variant of Tiger with a distinct visual appearance. Community tier rankings place it at S-tier alongside its base form.
strengths: Mutation variant of S-tier Tiger with distinct visual appearance
weaknesses: Specific ability differences from base Tiger not verified from current sources
